title: Skywatcher Analysis Coverage Report
description: Per-run record of which lenses ran, which degraded, and which could not run. Exists so that a check which never ran is distinguishable from a check that ran and found nothing.

complete.description: False whenever any required lens is MISSING, DEGRADED, or NOT_APPLICABLE. Fail-closed: completion is asserted only when every required lens is SATISFIED.

reason.description: Mandatory for every state other than SATISFIED. A lens that did not run without a stated cause is the outcome this record exists to prevent.

thresholds_applied.description: Provenance for every threshold this lens executed, per ADR v2.1 A2.
